metadata.title: OneHealth DataSpace Dashboard
metadata.description: Operational lifecycle dashboard for OneHealth DataSpace services.

aria.lifecycleSection: Choose a OneHealth DataSpace lifecycle capability
aria.openService: Open {service} service in a new tab

slogan.line2: A complete operational lifecycle for One Health data

panel.localNote: This option is shown locally in the dashboard.
panel.emptyPrompt: Select a service to explore its role in the lifecycle and access its operational endpoint.

SHARE.title: Share
SHARE.description: Securely share data with other participants
SHARE.detail: Exchange One Health data with other Data Space participants in an interoperable and trusted way using EDC connectors.

COMPUTE.title: Compute
COMPUTE.detail: Launch HPC workloads through an interactive environment.

ANALYZE.title: Analyze
ANALYZE.detail: Explore and analyze large datasets to transform them into useful insights using Big Data technologies.

STORE.title: Store
STORE.detail: Keep your source data, derived outputs, and other project data in accesible, high-performance storage.

DELIVER.title: Deliver
DELIVER.description: Expose results as services and applications
DELIVER.detail: Publish applications and service endpoints through cloud services under your control.

ANONYMIX.title: Anonymix
ANONYMIX.detail: Anonymize sensitive data and assess re-identification risk through controlled workflows before it is shared, analyzed, or distributed.

CLEVER.title: Clever
CLEVER.detail: Explore and monitor data through interactive visualization tools.
